enemies.name: Chainsaw Majini
enemies.danger: One chainsaw hit kills outright, whatever your health.
tactics: Grenade or flash to stun, head shots, then melee - only once the saw has stopped (it fakes stuns)
A rocket launcher or magnum ends it fastest
It jumps to the upper level: the stairs are no refuge
Keep a long escape line and never let it close
enemies.evidence: Ship Deck's set list 7 = the guide's 7 chainsaw drops; live maximum 7000 / 15000 (the guide's red 7000, blue 13500-15000)

enemies.name: Executioner Majini
enemies.danger: A giant axe whose swing takes most of your health; it shrugs off normal hits.
enemies.weak_point: head (extra damage); stun it, then melee
tactics: Stun it - flash grenade, an explosive barrel, head shots - then finish with a magnum or melee
Never stand in front of the overhead swing: circle and keep range
Proximity mines on its path
Public Assembly: only one is alive at a time (kills 20, 50, 70); the bus is a safe spot
enemies.evidence: a live frame identified uEm20 in Public Assembly as the executioner (re5-enemy-cast.md); set lists 3 (Public Assembly) and 2 (Prison) = the guide's; live maximum 8000 / 15000 = the guide's

enemies.name: Executioner Majini (red)
enemies.danger: The Prison's red Executioner: the same axe, far more health.
enemies.weak_point: head; the pink zone on its back
tactics: Stun it, then a magnum or melee
Shoot the pink zone on its back
Mines on its path; never in front of the swing
Prison: one at the start, then at kills 50 and 120
enemies.evidence: Prison's set list 3 = the guide's 3 red Executioners; live maximum 20000; the live crop shows the red figure

enemies.name: Gatling Gun Majini
enemies.danger: Constant gatling fire shreds your health at any range once it has a line on you.
enemies.weak_point: head (a stun); the backpack is bulletproof
tactics: Break line of sight, use cover, keep moving
Magnum head shot, then melee while it is stunned
Proximity mines - it shrugs off incendiary and electric rounds
Missile Area: kills 20, 60 (yellow) and 90 (red)
enemies.evidence: Missile Area's set list 3 = the guide's 3 (two yellow, one red); live maximum 4000 / 6000

enemies.name: Giant Majini
enemies.danger: Nearly 3 m tall with a spiked mace; its shout calls the others.
enemies.weak_point: torso and legs (the mask is invulnerable)
tactics: Shoot the legs or torso until it kneels, then melee
Shotgun or magnum from range
Fire hurts it
enemies.evidence: set lists Village 4 and Ancient Ruins 5 = the guide's Giants; live maximum 4000

enemies.name: Jill Valentine (enemy)
enemies.danger: Mind-controlled Jill: fast acrobatic melee and gunfire.
tactics: Restrain her, then hit the device on her chest
Do not trade fire with her body
enemies.evidence: its model (em9200, rendered) is a blonde woman in a black suit; one placement in a Public Assembly set

enemies.name: Reaper
enemies.danger: Its scythe grab can kill outright; it spits acid and its shell deflects bullets.
enemies.weak_point: the pale sacs on its belly (and back)
tactics: Wait until it rears up, then shoot the belly sac
A flash grenade stuns it
Stay at range: it can strike while dying
The Mines: kills 30, 70 and 90
enemies.evidence: The Mines' set list 3 = the guide's 3 Reapers; live maximum 1500

enemies.name: Adjule
enemies.danger: A Plaga dog: fast lunges, worst in tight spaces.
tactics: Shotgun as it leaps
Fight it in open ground
enemies.evidence: its model (em3000, rendered) is a black dog with bone spikes; placed only by The Mines' Reunion set (13)

enemies.name: Big Man Majini
enemies.danger: Huge strength, punches and grabs; gets straight back up and cannot be knocked down while his arms are up.
enemies.weak_point: head and legs (no armour); melee while he kneels
tactics: Keep your distance: shotgun or magnum
Stagger him with a leg or head shot, then melee while he kneels
Never trade blows while his arms are raised
enemies.evidence: Prison's set list has 14 = the guide's 14 Big Men; The Mines 7 (the guide's 2 + 3 by region, one in the upper tunnel, more waiting); live maximum 4000 = the guide's
enemies.spawns: by region (The Mines: A 2, B 3, +1 upper tunnel); Prison 14 through the round

enemies.name: Cephalo
enemies.danger: A Majini's head bursts into a whipping Plaga with long reach and more power than its host.
tactics: Flash grenade
Shotgun at close range
Avoid head criticals where they hatch (Missile Area, Ship Deck late in the round)
enemies.evidence: seen live only on town-Majini stages (Prison, Public Assembly), maximum 600; its model (em0d00, rendered) is a whip-tentacle Plaga; not in the set lists (it hatches from a host)

enemies.name: Duvalia
enemies.danger: A Plaga with an armoured shell that opens at close range and swallows you.
enemies.weak_point: the parasite while the shell is open; light
tactics: Flash grenade
Shoot it while the shell is open
Keep your distance
enemies.evidence: its model (em0e00, rendered) is a great fleshy petal mass - the Duvalia's open shell; seen live in the Experimental Facility at 600 (the guide gives Ancient Ruins hosts, ~7000 with the host)

enemies.name: Kipepeo
enemies.danger: A flying Plaga whose tail whip hits very hard.
tactics: Flash grenade
Shotgun or machine gun while it hovers slowly
enemies.evidence: seen live only in the Village (the guide's only Kipepeo stage, 0-6 a round), maximum 1000 = the guide's, and its model (em0c00, rendered) is a winged flyer; not in the set lists (they hatch)

enemies.name: Licker β
enemies.danger: Climbs walls and ceilings, pounces in packs and lashes with a long tongue.
enemies.weak_point: its heart, once it is flipped over
tactics: Head shot to flip it, then stomp or stab the exposed heart
Group them and grenade from range
Never stand inside tongue reach - they hunt by sound
enemies.evidence: named live (enemy_kinds); set list 72 = the guide's 30 + 42 by region; live maximum 900

enemies.name: Agitator Majini
enemies.danger: The tougher megaphone Majini who rouses the crowd; no extra attack of his own.
tactics: Head shots, then melee
He has twice a Majini's health: a shotgun or magnum shot first
enemies.evidence: one per Public Assembly round in its set list, live maximum 1400 = the guide's Agitator (1400), and its model (em2100, rendered) is the Agitator's sunglasses and dark shirt; the bot lists the class among the dynamite carriers (re5_switch.DYNAMITE_CLASSES)

enemies.name: Base Majini
enemies.danger: Armed soldiers in squads: handguns, grenades, stun rods and rocket launchers; armour and shields soak shots.
tactics: Aim at exposed parts - armour deflects
Kill the rocket-launcher soldiers on sight (kills 10-80)
Strafe sideways when one aims a rocket
enemies.evidence: the Experimental Facility's set list 77 = the guide's 60 by region + 9 rocket soldiers + 8 at the start; live maximum 800 (the guide's Base Majini)
enemies.notes: the rocket-launcher variant (1000 health) is the stage's heavy, nine of them by kill count

enemies.name: Bui Kichwa
enemies.danger: Small spider-like Plagas in packs that leap and cling.
tactics: One bullet or a stomp
A flash grenade clears a group
Keep moving so they cannot cling
enemies.evidence: the Village set list 26 = the guide's 10 + 16 Bui Kichwa; live maximum 200 = the guide's; the live crop shows a many-legged crawler (the bot's LOW_BODIES note calls it a dog)

enemies.name: Majini
enemies.danger: Comes in crowds; one holds you while the others swing, and the throwers (dynamite, bottles, crossbows) hit from range.
tactics: Head or knee shot to stagger, then melee (+5 s)
Shoot a lit dynamite stick in his hand: it takes out the group
A clump: grenade or an explosive barrel
Head criticals can hatch a Cephalo - a knee shot and melee avoids it
enemies.evidence: named live (gbox/mercs/enemy_kinds.py); live maximum 800, the guide's male Majini; the bulk of every town stage's set list (Public Assembly 121, Prison 130 ...)

enemies.name: Majini (female)
enemies.danger: The town women: fast grabs in a crowd; some carry bottles to throw.
tactics: Stagger with a head or knee shot, then melee
The red- and green-dress women at the start hatch a Cephalo half the time: kill them cleanly
enemies.evidence: named live (enemy_kinds); live maximum 700 (the guide's women); Public Assembly's set list 24

enemies.name: Wetlands Majini
enemies.danger: Long jumps and high endurance; spears and explosive arrows from range, shield bearers block shots.
enemies.weak_point: head; the legs around a shield
tactics: Head shot, then melee
Kill the explosive-arrow archers first
A shield bearer: shoot his legs or wait for the shield to drop
Torch Majini (1500): shotgun or magnum, a flash ready for its Plaga
enemies.evidence: the Village (125) and Ancient Ruins (144) set lists' bulk class, the only two stages the guide gives Wetlands Majini; live maximum 700 / 900 / 600 (the guide's 670-700, 900 at the Village start, 620 archers)

enemies.name: Chicken
enemies.danger: Harmless.
tactics: Never a target while anything else lives
enemies.evidence: its model (em6200, rendered) is a chicken; health 1; one in every stage's set list and two in The Mines = the guide's chickens
